goal: Complete the ten-domain Python-only development panel with a source-only Bayesian biological-inference notebook, using the general factory including coverage-aware fixture discovery.
source_selection: Operator choice within broad ten-notebook scope after optional earlier preference remained unanswered. No claimed user selection of this specific notebook. Imaging141remains held, not executed or silently reused.
scientific_contract: Workers assess the full unchanged original notebook. No manually selected subset, preauthored question, endpoints, answers or task-specific fixes. A faithful validated task or honest recorded rejection is acceptable.

resource_and_time_policy.solver_timeout_status: Provisional; separately revisitable before solver execution
resource_and_time_policy.software_choice: Open: alternative tools are allowed if outputs meet the validated public contract; broad implementation independence is not promised.
resource_and_time_policy.reward: binary; all required checks must pass
resource_and_time_policy.target: A realistic scientific analysis task with verifiable outputs, rather than reproducing every implementation detail of the notebook.
resource_and_time_policy.specification_scope: Draft scientific question, supplied input derivations, selected output schemas and proposed comparison rules. Validate rules before solving.
resource_and_time_policy.endpoint_recovery: Preparation remains append-only. Construction may recover required scientific endpoints by faithful recomputation of unchanged original source calls on the same original inputs and required state, with separate provenance and independent validation. No invented analysis, broken-source repair, changed methods/inputs or silent endpoint omission.

publication: Not automatic; preserve MIT notice and data lineage, review actual materialized inputs and qualification before any public release.
